verdict.rationale: Lambda's billing docs say ODC prices instances by hourly usage but bills in one-minute increments, which meets the per-minute granularity in the story. A community report shows billing is tied to the instance being in a running/attached state regardless of idle vs. in-use; that is consistent with 'billed while running', not a contradiction of the documented model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that billing stops at termination (or any stop/pause semantics), and independent corroboration of the one-minute increment behavior.
